title: Paid Media Specialist
skills: Develop and execute performance marketing strategies: Plan, implement, and optimize multi-channel campaigns (paid social, PPC, display advertising, etc.) to meet acquisition, conversion, and ROI goals.

Analyze data and optimize campaigns: Use analytical tools to track, analyze, and report on key performance metrics. Continuously optimize campaigns based on insights to maximize performance and efficiency.

Collaborate with creative and content teams: Work closely with creative teams to develop high-performing ad creatives, landing pages, and other assets to improve campaign performance and user experience.

Reporting and insights: Generate regular reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders, highlighting key findings, performance trends, and recommendations for optimization.
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or related field. Master's degree or relevant certifications are a plus.
2-3+ years of proven experience in performance marketing, with a focus on user acquisition, conversion optimization, and ROI-driven campaigns.
Expertise in Google Ads and/or Facebook Ads Manager, as well as analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics
Advanced computer skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Suite Products (Google Slides, Google Sheets, etc.)
Hands on experience in managing monthly campaign budgets from $30k+
Client management and client-facing experience desirable
Strong analytical skills and ability to interpret complex data to derive actionable insights.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities and strategies.
Certifications in Google Ads, Facebook Blueprint, or other relevant platforms are desirable.
Ecommerce and agency experience desirable
description:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

title: Testing & Optimization Specialist
skills: Partner with Sr. Manager of Digital Optimization, Digital Product Managers, web UX designers, and other optimization team members to translate testing strategy into detailed, specification-ready test plans
Define test mechanics—what will be tested, how variations will differ, which audiences are included, and what success looks like
Build and configure Adobe Target experiences with precision, including targeting logic, traffic allocation, and tracking parameters
Validate measurement design—confirm that KPIs are properly instrumented in Adobe Analytics and will actually capture what matters
Develop test variations working closely with designers and developers, ensuring variations accurately test the intended hypothesis

Own test operations within our established processes—execute Development and/or QA validation handoffs, actively monitor test performance and flag issues, drive tests through launch and closure, and hold to sprint timelines and SLAs
Configure analytical dashboards in Adobe Analytics to monitor test performance and enable real-time visibility into results
Conduct pre-test analysis using Adobe Analytics to establish baselines and inform test calibration
Build and document test plans— clearly capture aligned hypothesis, specify measurement parameters and KPI tracking, and ensure alignment between strategy and execution
Identify and surface execution considerations early (traffic volume, audience overlap, measurement gaps, test conflicts) so they can be addressed before launch
Maintain clear documentation so test logic is transparent and results can be reliably interpreted
Work closely with the Sr Manager of Optimization to ensure test plans align with strategy and measurement is sound
Document test results, and support post-test analysis and results interpretation
Support Learning Repository updates and stakeholder shake-outs as needed

Hands-on experience executing web testing using Adobe Target or an equivalent platform (e.g., Optimizely, Visual Web Optimizer, etc) —you've built and troubleshot A/B tests, multivariate tests, and segment-based experiences at scale
Hands-on experience with web analytical tools such as Adobe Analytics—you can navigate dashboards, understand event tracking, build custom segments, and interpret test results reliably
Front-end development background with working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—you understand how variations are built and can communicate technical requirements clearly to developers
Strong understanding of testing methodology including statistical significance, sample sizing, and test duration—you know why these details matter
Analytical and data-driven mindset—you think critically about problem statements and measurement design; you ask clarifying questions when something seems unclear
Accountability and ownership—you track details meticulously and own test quality end-to-end; you escalate blockers rather than letting them slide
Cross-functional collaboration—you partner effectively with Product Managers, UX, Development, and Analytics teams; you communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences
Proactive problem-solving—you anticipate issues, surface them early, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be told what to do
Attention to detail and organizational skill—you manage multiple concurrent tests, maintain clear documentation, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
Intellectual curiosity—you're genuinely interested in understanding customer behavior and business context; you ask "why" questions about the tests we run
2-3+ years in digital marketing, web optimization, experimentation, or related analytics roles
Experience with B2B SaaS or e-commerce testing scenarios as plus
Familiarity with analytics tools (Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Hotjar, etc.)
Experience working with agile teams and methodologies
Exposure to audience activation platforms (Adobe Audience Manager, DMPs, etc.)
Interest in how AI and automation can enhance testing and optimization work
Energetic and forward-thinking; comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
Collaborative mindset; you thrive working with diverse teams toward shared goals
Growth-oriented; you're eager to develop deeper expertise in optimization and digital strategy
Embraces change and is energized by new ideas and technologies

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. description:
About the job

Testing and Optimization Specialist

Are you passionate about using data and experimentation to improve how customers experience our digital journey? Do you combine technical skill with critical thinking? If so, we want to meet you.

The Optimization and Personalization team within the Digital Experience Strategy & Optimization team at TR drives meaningful customer experiences through rigorous experimentation and personalization. Our work is foundational to TR's strategic investment in eCommerce and digital capability—turning data and insights into experiences that matter

About The Role

In this opportunity as a Testing and Optimization Specialist, you will be the execution engine for our testing program—translating strategy into high-quality test plans that generate real business insights.

Specifically, You Will

Test Planning & Execution


Partner with Sr. Manager of Digital Optimization, Digital Product Managers, web UX designers, and other optimization team members to translate testing strategy into detailed, specification-ready test plans
Define test mechanics—what will be tested, how variations will differ, which audiences are included, and what success looks like
Build and configure Adobe Target experiences with precision, including targeting logic, traffic allocation, and tracking parameters
Validate measurement design—confirm that KPIs are properly instrumented in Adobe Analytics and will actually capture what matters
Develop test variations working closely with designers and developers, ensuring variations accurately test the intended hypothesis
Own test operations within our established processes—execute Development and/or QA validation handoffs, actively monitor test performance and flag issues, drive tests through launch and closure, and hold to sprint timelines and SLAs
Configure analytical dashboards in Adobe Analytics to monitor test performance and enable real-time visibility into results


Quality Assurance & Partnership


Conduct pre-test analysis using Adobe Analytics to establish baselines and inform test calibration
Build and document test plans— clearly capture aligned hypothesis, specify measurement parameters and KPI tracking, and ensure alignment between strategy and execution
Identify and surface execution considerations early (traffic volume, audience overlap, measurement gaps, test conflicts) so they can be addressed before launch
Maintain clear documentation so test logic is transparent and results can be reliably interpreted
Work closely with the Sr Manager of Optimization to ensure test plans align with strategy and measurement is sound


Learning & Communication


Document test results, and support post-test analysis and results interpretation
Support Learning Repository updates and stakeholder shake-outs as needed


About You

You're a fit for this role if your background includes:

Required Technical Skills


Hands-on experience executing web testing using Adobe Target or an equivalent platform (e.g., Optimizely, Visual Web Optimizer, etc) —you've built and troubleshot A/B tests, multivariate tests, and segment-based experiences at scale
Hands-on experience with web analytical tools such as Adobe Analytics—you can navigate dashboards, understand event tracking, build custom segments, and interpret test results reliably
Front-end development background with working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript—you understand how variations are built and can communicate technical requirements clearly to developers
Strong understanding of testing methodology including statistical significance, sample sizing, and test duration—you know why these details matter


Required Soft Skills


Analytical and data-driven mindset—you think critically about problem statements and measurement design; you ask clarifying questions when something seems unclear
Accountability and ownership—you track details meticulously and own test quality end-to-end; you escalate blockers rather than letting them slide
Cross-functional collaboration—you partner effectively with Product Managers, UX, Development, and Analytics teams; you communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences
Proactive problem-solving—you anticipate issues, surface them early, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be told what to do
Attention to detail and organizational skill—you manage multiple concurrent tests, maintain clear documentation, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
Intellectual curiosity—you're genuinely interested in understanding customer behavior and business context; you ask "why" questions about the tests we run


Preferred Experience


2-3+ years in digital marketing, web optimization, experimentation, or related analytics roles
Experience with B2B SaaS or e-commerce testing scenarios as plus
Familiarity with analytics tools (Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Hotjar, etc.)
Experience working with agile teams and methodologies
Exposure to audience activation platforms (Adobe Audience Manager, DMPs, etc.)
Interest in how AI and automation can enhance testing and optimization work


Personal Qualities


Energetic and forward-thinking; comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
Collaborative mindset; you thrive working with diverse teams toward shared goals
Growth-oriented; you're eager to develop deeper expertise in optimization and digital strategy
Embraces change and is energized by new ideas and technologies


What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Trabajo en equipo: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.


OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. description:
About the job

¿Sabes calificar prospectos B2B, generar confianza por WhatsApp y convertir conversaciones en reuniones que se presentan?

En Ultrasonic desarrollamos y comercializamos tecnología HIFU de alta gama para clínicas estéticas y médicos en España, México y USA. Somos una empresa en expansión con producto físico real, marca consolidada y casos de éxito documentados. Buscamos un Appointment Setter B2B profesional para incorporarse al equipo comercial remoto.




Lo que te diferencia de otros puestos de setting

Leads reales generados por nuestras campañas de marketing. No prospectas en frío. Ultrasonic invierte en campañas activas de WhatsApp, retargeting y captación digital. Los prospectos llegan a ti ya interesados — tu trabajo es calificarlos, nutrirlos y convertirlos en reuniones que se cierran en venta.




Tu función va más allá de agendar. Eres el primer eslabón de la cadena de venta. Cada reunión que agendas es una oportunidad real de venta de 6, 000 a 18,000 USD. La calidad de tu trabajo determina directamente cuánto cierra el equipo — y cuánto cobras tú.




Plan de onboarding estructurado y academia de producto. No te dejamos solo/a. Desde el día 1 tienes acceso a un plan de incorporación progresivo, sesiones de formación con la Dirección Comercial, academia con toda la información técnica del producto y casos clínicos reales. Dominarás el producto antes de hablar con tu primer prospecto.




Ticket de venta de 6, 000 a 18,000 USD. Cada reunión que agendas y se presenta tiene peso real. Cada venta que genera tu reunión te paga.




Tú eliges tu modalidad. Dos opciones desde el primer día: base fija + comisión (SAFE) o comisión pura con mayor pago por reunión (HUNTER). Sin imposiciones.




Progresión real. El sistema tiene tres niveles — SAFE, HUNTER y SENIOR — con criterios claros y transparentes para avanzar. No hay techos artificiales.




Qué hace un Setter en Ultrasonic

Tu función es una sola: agendar reuniones válidas con prospectos calificados para el

equipo de Closers. Una reunión válida es aquella donde el prospecto se presenta, tiene el

BANT completo, ha recibido y visto el material de nutrición, y confirma asistencia de forma

activa.

No cierras ventas. No gestionas logística. No haces soporte. Tu tiempo es para calificar, nutrir y

agendar.




El sistema de comisiones — transparente y sin letra pequeña

Tienes dos modalidades desde el primer día. La modalidad SAFE incluye una base fija de $400

USD más comisión por cada reunión válida y por cada venta cerrada. La modalidad HUNTER

es 100% comisión con tarifas más altas por reunión y por venta. Ambas incluyen primas por

show rate y bonos mensuales por volumen que se acumulan sobre todo lo demás.




Para que te hagas una idea real de lo que significa en ingresos:




Un Setter en SAFE durante el tercer mes, con 25 reuniones válidas y 5 ventas cerradas por el

equipo, ingresa alrededor de $2,050 USD.

Un Setter en HUNTER en el cuarto mes, con 30 reuniones y 6 ventas, llega a $3,000 USD.

Con 50 reuniones mensuales, 10 ventas y show rate por encima del 78%, el ingreso sube a

$5,100 USD.




En nivel SENIOR, con 80 reuniones y 16 ventas, el ingreso mensual alcanza los $8,300 USD. Y

el techo documentado del sistema, con 100 reuniones y 20 ventas, está en $10,500 USD.




El detalle completo del sistema de comisiones, los criterios de cada modalidad y la tabla de

bonos están disponibles en el proceso de selección. Cuando te inscribes, accedes a toda la

información antes de tomar ninguna decisión.




Todos los pagos en USD. Ciclos quincenales o mensuales según acuerdo. Previa factura.




La rampa de objetivos — sin presión desde el primer día

No te exigimos el máximo desde el primer día. El sistema tiene una rampa progresiva: 15

reuniones en el primer mes para aprender el sistema, 20 en el segundo para consolidar el ritmo,

25 en el tercero como velocidad de crucero, y 30 a partir del cuarto mes como nivel HUNTER

estable. Los objetivos y criterios completos de cada fase están detallados en el proceso de

selección.




Lo que buscamos

Mínimo 1 año de experiencia en ventas, setting o gestión de prospectos B2B demostrable.

Profesional independiente con capacidad de emitir facturas. Disponibilidad en horario de México

o España (especialmente tardes). Conexión estable, ordenador propio y capacidad de grabar

llamadas. Mentalidad de proceso: no buscamos a alguien que improvise, buscamos a alguien

que ejecute un sistema.




Perfil ideal: Setter con experiencia en infoproductos, tecnología o sector salud que quiere

trabajar con un producto físico real de ticket alto y un equipo estructurado.




Ubicación preferente: México, Colombia (LATAM) o España.




El proceso de selección

Registro → Vídeo de presentación (2 min) → Video Pitch (5 min con el producto) → Entrevista con Roleplay → Contrato

El proceso completo dura menos de una semana. Incorporación inmediata. Hay leads activos

ahora mismo.




Por qué Ultrasonic

Somos una empresa con producto físico real, certificaciones CE, casos clínicos documentados y un equipo que lleva años en el sector. No somos una agencia de marketing que vende cursos. Vendemos equipos que se instalan en clínicas reales y generan ingresosreales para nuestros clientes. Eso hace que el producto se venda cuando se presenta bien — y eso es exactamente lo que tú vas a hacer.




¿Es esto lo que estás buscando?

Haz clic en "Solicitar empleo" y accede a nuestra web, donde encontrarás toda la información detallada del puesto, el sistema de comisiones completo y el formulario de registro. El proceso es rápido y podrás revisar todo antes de comprometerte con nada.

Hay leads activos ahora mismo. Incorporación inmediata.

At Mastercard, our Advisors & Consulting Services (ACS) group helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.

Make an Impact as an Associate Consultant

As an Associate Consultant, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through taking ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality and more.

Specialization Track

We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs, and we are recruiting for four career tracks that make up our team. Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?

About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, alongside excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team with in-depth research, and working collaboratively to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in supporting the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external data sources and synthesizing into market research content assets.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth primary and secondary research into IT markets and their impact on industries, namely energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing. 
 Have in-depth knowledge/experience and understanding in energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing business operations, either through working in these industries or executing consulting/research engagements 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies.

 Participate in ongoing professional development and contribute to team knowledge sharing. 
 Synthesize raw data into information and meaningful insights and deliver tailored content components and assets that address key business requirements. 
 Contribute to the creation of written research studies and presentations summarizing findings for internal and external stakeholders

2-3 years of experience in market research, consulting, or analysis, ideally in the information technology sector, with knowledge in the energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing domain, with a flair toward writing research content.

Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.

Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.

Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new marker research methods and tools, analytical mindset, and a collaborative, supportive approach to teamwork.

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. About the job

Role:: Python Automation Engineer

Location: Remote(Mexico)

Role Type: Full Time




Must Have Skills

• Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking with data / algorithm testing experience

• Proficient in backend and API testing

• Extensive Experience with Python automation (writing and maintaining tests)

• Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or similar

• Strong SQL and database validation skills




Good to Have

• Azure DevOps CI/CD

• C# or TypeScript




Job Description

Python QA Engineer is responsible for validating backend services, data processing, and calculation logic that power the Nexus application.

Unlike UI-focused testing, this role emphasizes end-to-end data validation across services, APIs, and databases, ensuring that complex algorithms and backend workflows produce accurate and reliable results.

The QA engineer will work closely with developers, product owners, and data/analysis teams to ensure high-quality delivery in a fast-paced Agile environment.




Key Responsibilities

• Test backend services (e.g., Azure Functions)

• Validate data flow, calculations, and algorithm outputs

• Perform API testing (manual + automation)

• Execute SQL-based data validation across systems

• Create and execute test cases, regression, and defect tracking

• Maintain Python-based automation and support CI/CD pipelines

About the job

Test Coordinator




We're looking for a proactive, community-minded professional to help run the day-to-day operations of our Game Tester platform. In this multi-faceted role, you'll support tester communities across Discord, email, and in-platform channels, review and refine test submissions to ensure quality standards are met, and act as a key point of contact for clients — guiding their testing requirements and helping troubleshoot issues when submissions fall short. You'll balance hands-on ownership with cross-functional collaboration, working closely with support, community, and client teams to keep testing running smoothly, testers engaged, and clients confident in the value we deliver.




Please note this is a temporary 6-month contract with possibility for extension or permanent employment.




What You Will Do:




Test Coordination

Review and test each submission for approval.
Monitor and manage live test invites.
Cooperate directly with clients to deliver the best results for their needs.
Own and manage designated client accounts as required.
Manage and support testers during testing phases.
Create Discord servers or channels to account for test needs.




Tester Reviews

Review and rate all tester feedback submitted on the platform.
Regularly review testers for promotion or demotion in our VIP programme.
Create guidance and best practice documentation for testers.
Revoke tester feedback and issue warnings for poor behaviour on platform.




Community Management

Engage with community directly to keep discussion active and heathy.
Moderate discussion and enforce server rules.
Work with helper and moderation volunteers.
Set up and organise social events, competitions, and game nights.
Set up and award winners of weekly giveaways.
Announce new updates and features, engaging the most interest as possible.




Social Media

Monitor game release dates and supply information to colleagues for creation of launch trailers.
Scour social media looking for developers attempting to recruit for play tests to introduce ourselves.




Please note: This list is not exhaustive, and your day-to-day responsibilities will likely adapt and change over time depending on business needs and resources.




To Be Successful You Will Have:

1+ years experience with community management and/or coordinating events on schedule and within scope.
Outstanding communication and writing skills, including ability to ask questions or share information with clarity and brevity.
Fluency in English is mandatory.
Coordination skills, business acumen, and the ability to work with lots of moving pieces.
Passion about our customers, our technology, and our people.
Analytical/problem solving skills, demonstrated success in driving complex programs .
Be a motivated self-starter.




What Game Tester needs…

Our primary focus is on providing the best possible service to every developer and publisher that uses our platform. This has meant a never-ending review of our platform and processes. Always looking to improve the way things are done, reduce unnecessary workload and ultimately make the best possible platform for our partners.

We are a small team in a large organization where every single employee has a huge impact on the success of our platform. For this reason, we need self-starters and self-thinkers. Someone that can identify pain-points and propose solutions. You will need to be highly adaptable as our business grows and be willing to offer your support where it is most needed at all times.

You will be joining us for a roller coaster journey where your passionate commitment and contribution will be a key pillar in our long-term success, leading to many opportunities for growth in our business.

If you have what it takes, we would love to talk!




What you can expect in return:

The opportunity to work with world-leading companies, opening the door to limitless opportunities.
Working with a Forbes-listed World-Leader in “Best Remote employer”, “Top employer of Women” and “Top employer for Diversity”.

Lionbridge Games help our customers deliver the seamless experience they envision to any audience around the world, without compromise. Our team of global gamers helps developers, publishers and platform-holders complete thousands of game audio, localization, testing and other player experience projects on time and on budget. Learn more at games.lionbridge.com.

Job Summary

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). He/She handles and processes customers' issues and complaint phone calls (i.e., calls to UPS Corporate Headquarters, Global Business Services, and UPS telephone package line), emails, faxes, and letters. This position is responsible for handling calls originally directed to UPS senior management and Management Committee members, managing the resolution process and reporting back to UPS senior management and Management Committee members on issue and complaint resolutions. The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
About the job

Department: Customer Relations

Location: Mexico - Monterrey



Description

Customer retention and market expansion. This role provides end-to-end account and relationship support to our best customers, driving best practices and innovation to create more value for the business”. The goal is to increase customer satisfaction, retention and adoption of key product and service features within a particular market segment. 

Key Responsibilities

• Provide end-to-end, single point of contact support for our best customers – the As – from order entry and inquiry to AR support and issue resolution.
• Proactively anticipate customer needs and identify any potential opportunities or issues. Create recommendations and facilitate actions accordingly. (Requires a strong knowledge of the account, products, and daily interaction on a high level).
• Support the marketing strategy to create new relationships, new customers, new markets.
• Serve as the customers’ voice, including marketing, product, professional services and sales.
• Establish and deepen relationships with customers by understanding their business objectives and providing exemplary support. 
• Communicate frequently with customers on updates, information, concerns and suggestions.
• Mine various communication feedback and benchmark data, launch and/or support innovative efforts to drive new efforts and change to meet the customers’ perceived expectations and needs.
• Identify potential upsell, new product, substitution or replacement opportunities, slow moving products as well as obsolete/excess inventory in an effort to create a value strategy specific to the opportunity.
• Manage deliverables specific to meeting the team’s strategic objectives.
• Use customer benchmark data to highlight customers’ strategic success and provide ongoing recommendations for further optimization.
• Communicate and coordinate with internal departments (Product Managers/Sales Team/Marketing).
• Organize workflow to meet customer timeframes (coordinate with main buyer / purchaser – setting up and defining process per customer’s requirements).
• Complete forms, applications and/or customer requests.
• Business travel required as needed. Participate in customer visits, trade shows and/or events.
• Performs other duties as required or assigned.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Scholarship: Bachelor’s degree in business management or relations preferably.

Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience or training in customer service, customer experience, customer success, or a related field (required).

Skills:

• Dependable, self-motivated, and displays initiative
• Results and goal oriented
• Customer growth oriented
• Effective communication skills – written & verbal, internal & external customers
• Strong problem analysis and problem-solving skills, innovative
• Professional in all manners
• High-level attention to detail, high level accuracy and reliable results 

Initial formation: Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

About the job

Ecommerce Paid Media Creative Strategist 

Remote | Full-Time | Fluent English Required

Time: 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (Hours are flexible, we care about performance not clocks).

Salary: Starting at approximately $2,000 USD/month + performance-based bonuses




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand creating sunglasses that solve problems. Our products include tangle-free aviators, floating sunglasses, foldable pocket shades, mood-boosting lenses, UV400 protection, and other functional designs.




We are a lean, fast-moving e-commerce company selling through Shopify, TikTok Shop, Amazon, wholesale, affiliates, influencers, and other channels. We move quickly, test constantly, and value ownership, initiative, and measurable results.




About the Role

We are looking for a Creative Paid Media Strategist who understands how to turn creative into business results.




You will connect marketing, creative, paid media, copywriting, website conversion, and customer psychology. You will guide strategy, develop ideas, identify what is working and what is not, and turn products, customer problems, and business goals into creative that drives attention, clicks, conversions, and revenue.




You need to recognize strong creative, identify what is missing, explain how to improve it, and execute when necessary instead of simply delegating.




Your Primary Mission

Turn products, customer insights, marketing goals, and performance data into creative strategies that capture attention, communicate value, create desire, and drive measurable e-commerce growth.




Customer Insight → Strategy → Concept → Copy → Production → Launch → Analysis → Optimization.




What You Will Do

1) Paid Media Creative Strategy

Develop creative strategies for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google, and other relevant platforms.
Identify marketing angles for products, promotions, launches, and customer segments.
Develop concepts based on customer pain points, product benefits, offers, and business goals.
Create briefs outlining the target customer, hook, message, visual direction, and desired action.
Recommend the footage, visuals, copy, demonstrations, and assets needed to execute each concept.
Develop variations to test hooks, angles, messages, formats, and calls to action.
Review ads and identify opportunities to improve attention, engagement, and conversion.




2) Creative Concepts, Hooks & Angles

Develop concepts based on customer behavior, product benefits, trends, and performance data.
Create different marketing angles based on customer motivations.
Develop hooks that create curiosity, communicate a problem, generate emotion, or introduce a compelling benefit.
Create educational, lifestyle, emotional, comparison, demonstration, and direct-response concepts.
Turn reviews, complaints, questions, and objections into creative opportunities.
Research competitors and identify creative gaps and opportunities.
Continuously bring new ideas to the team.




3) Copywriting & Marketing Messaging

Develop and improve paid ad copy, video hooks, on-screen text, headlines, and calls to action.
Turn product features into clear customer-focused benefits.
Create messaging that addresses customer objections, frustrations, desires, and reasons not to purchase.
Identify when copy is vague, generic, unclear, or focused only on product features.
Write or improve product, promotional, landing page, email, SMS, and campaign messaging.
Develop messaging variations to test different motivations, benefits, emotional appeals, urgency, and calls to action.




4) Video & Visual Creative Direction

Review video concepts and edits to determine whether they communicate the intended marketing message.
Evaluate whether the opening seconds capture attention and encourage continued viewing.
Guide editors on hooks, pacing, storytelling, messaging, product demonstrations, and calls to action.
Identify when a video looks polished but does not communicate a clear problem, benefit, or reason to purchase.
Provide specific feedback explaining what should change and why.
Recommend the footage, visuals, sound, text, and creative elements needed.
Direct UGC-style, influencer-style, product-focused, founder-led, educational, and direct-response creative.




5) Website & Landing Page Conversion

Review the customer journey from advertisement to landing page, product page, and checkout to identify conversion problems.
Identify disconnects between advertising messages and the experience customers receive after clicking.
Recommend improvements to headlines, product messaging, visuals, demonstrations, page structure, and calls to action.
Make product benefits, features, use cases, and solutions clearer.
Recommend A/B tests for copy, imagery, videos, product positioning, and calls to action.
Identify customer objections that are not clearly addressed on the website.




6) Email, SMS & Lifecycle Marketing

Develop creative concepts for promotional emails, product launches, seasonal campaigns, and retention initiatives.
Review messaging to ensure customers understand the offer, product benefit, and reason to act.
Write or improve subject lines, headlines, body copy, calls to action, and promotional messaging.
Develop messaging for welcome, abandoned cart, retention, product education, and promotional campaigns.
Align email and SMS messaging with paid media, website, and broader campaign strategy.
Use customer pain points, benefits, reviews, and objections to develop stronger lifecycle marketing.




7) Performance & Creative Testing

Analyze CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, watch time, thumb-stop rate, engagement, and revenue.
Identify which hooks, messaging angles, benefits, visuals, and formats perform best.
Translate performance data into recommendations for future creatives.
Develop tests for hooks, messaging, visual styles, video structures, offers, and calls to action.
Identify which concepts should be scaled, improved, retested, or discontinued.




8) Research & Marketing Opportunities

Research reviews, complaints, questions, comments, and customer service conversations for creative insights.
Identify recurring customer problems, frustrations, desires, objections, and purchasing motivations.
Analyze competitor advertising, messaging, and creative strategies.
Research relevant advertising, consumer, cultural, and platform trends.
Use research to develop new hooks, angles, product messaging, and campaign concepts.




9) Campaigns & Product Launches

Develop creative strategies for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and major initiatives.
Define the target customer, problem, product benefit, and primary marketing message.
Develop campaign concepts, creative angles, hooks, copy, and visual direction.
Determine the assets required across advertising, website, email, SMS, and social media.

description:
About the job

TikTok Shop Growth Manager




EVMT Brands | Remote | Full-time | 2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance BONUS

EVMT Brands makes liquid chalk, the grip product trusted by 250,000+ athletes across powerlifting, CrossFit, climbing, and calisthenics. Amazon is locked in. TikTok Shop is wide open. We need someone to light the fuse.




We are not looking for someone to manage tasks. We are looking for someone who has done this before, knows what a winning TikTok Shop affiliate program looks like, and can walk in on day one and build it. This is your chance to own the channel, own the results, and build something that matters.




You will take full ownership of the program. We currently run the channel through an agency; your job is to take it over and bring it fully in-house, with the agency supporting the transition.




What Winning Looks Like

Six months in: a creator army of quality affiliates posting regularly, average GMV per video climbing, fulfillment rates above 50%, and a GMV Max library that actually delivers. You will have built the outreach process, the content standards, the re-engagement system, and the weekly reporting cadence from scratch. The program runs because of you..




Your Playbook

One Thing:

Turn liquid chalk creators into a high-converting TikTok Shop sales machine.




Own These First:

Run targeted creator outreach in Euka across all creator tiers, prioritizing signals that predict performance: niche fit, engagement quality, and posting consistency. Volume matters, but the goal is creators who actually post and convert.
Build and enforce a content standard: every video in GMV Max has a hook in the first 3 seconds, a product demo, proof, and a CTA, no exceptions
Analyze performance data to identify growth opportunities, propose experiments, and build a roadmap to scale TikTok Shop profitably.
Keep creators engaged: re-engagement flows for non-posters, posting deadlines, follow-up DMs, and accountability
Drive GMV Max performance: improve delivery rate, average GMV per video, and overall affiliate-attributed sales month over month
Manage and hold external agencies accountable through KPIs, testing plans, and performance reviews.




Daily and Weekly Hustle:

• Run outreach campaigns, review performance, kill what is not working, scale what is

• Review every creator video before it enters GMV Max, approve, reject, or provide exact feedback and hook scripts

• Track the full sample funnel: applications, approvals, delivered, fulfilled, videos posted

• Report weekly to the founder with clean numbers and clear recommendations

• Own the creator CRM, accurate status on every creator at every stage




Who You Are

• You have built a TikTok Shop affiliate program before and have the results to prove it. We want to see numbers: before and after GMV, creator pool size, fulfillment rates.

• You have owned a channel or program yourself, not run one piece of it inside a bigger team. When you describe your results, "I" should be doing most of the work in the sentence, not "we".

• You have managed 100+ creator relationships simultaneously and kept them moving

• You understand TikTok GMV Max deeply: how the delivery algorithm works, what makes a video clear the bar, how to build a library that performs

• You have built outreach processes from scratch, not just inherited someone else's system

• You know what a good hook looks like and can write one yourself

• Experience with Euka, JoinBrands, or similar creator outreach platforms

• Strong written English for creator DMs, hook scripts, and briefs

• Data-driven: comfortable in Google Sheets and AI tools, clean data entry is non-negotiable

• You do not wait to be told what to do. You identify the problem and fix it.

• Detail-oriented with a structured process for A/B testing. Design and prioritize structured experiments across creator outreach, content angles, incentives, product selection, and GMV Max strategy.




Bonus:

• Background in fitness, sports, or health categories on TikTok Shop

• Experience working directly with founders or small teams




Work Setup

Remote, full-time (Philippines or Latin America preferred)
40 hours per week, Monday through Friday
US Pacific Time business hours overlap required
Full-time and exclusive: no concurrent clients or side projects
Start date: as soon as possible




Compensation

2,000-2,500/month USD + Performance Bonus tied to affiliate GMV




This role grows: we plan to launch our second brand on TikTok Shop and expand both brands to Meta and Instagram. Deliver on TikTok, and the role becomes social commerce across two brands, with compensation revised upward as scope grows.




Why EVMT

The product is proven. The Amazon business is real. TikTok Shop is the next chapter and it is wide open. You will have direct access to the founder, a real budget, and full ownership of the channel. No bureaucracy. No hand-holding. Just a big opportunity and the trust to run with it.

We are not filling a seat. We are finding the person who builds this.

Shortlisted candidates will receive four short written questions before any interview.

title: Especialista de Marketing y E-commerce
description:
About the job

En Baking Alchemy desarrollamos soluciones innovadoras para la panadería y repostería profesional. Nuestro producto estrella es un aceite antiadherente de alto desempeño que facilita el engrasado y desmolde, ayudando a nuestros clientes a trabajar de forma más eficiente y consistente.




Formamos parte de Interlub Group, empresa mexicana con presencia internacional desde 1984, y de The Uncommon Lab, su plataforma de innovación enfocada en transformar conocimiento técnico en productos extraordinarios para el consumidor.




Buscamos a una persona creativa, analítica y orientada a resultados que impulse el posicionamiento y crecimiento de Baking Alchemy.




Tu misión




Construir una marca relevante, reconocida y cercana para profesionales y entusiastas de la panadería y repostería, integrando en una sola estrategia:




* Posicionamiento de marca.

* Trade marketing.

* E-commerce.

* Redes sociales y contenido digital.




La posición combinará estrategia y ejecución. Buscamos a alguien que pueda definir el rumbo de la marca, pero que también tenga la capacidad de implementar campañas, generar contenido, administrar canales digitales y activar los puntos de venta.




¿Qué harás?




Posicionamiento de marca




* Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia de marca de Baking Alchemy.

* Asegurar consistencia en mensajes, identidad visual y experiencia del cliente.

* Traducir la propuesta de valor del producto en comunicación clara y atractiva.

* Desarrollar campañas para aumentar el conocimiento, consideración y preferencia de marca.

* Identificar tendencias, audiencias y oportunidades de posicionamiento.




Trade marketing




* Diseñar activaciones, promociones y materiales para puntos de venta y distribuidores.

* Desarrollar exhibiciones, demostraciones y herramientas de apoyo comercial.

* Crear planes para incrementar rotación, recompra y visibilidad en tienda.

* Coordinar lanzamientos y campañas con el equipo comercial y los clientes.

* Medir el desempeño de promociones y acciones en punto de venta.




E-commerce




* Gestionar y desarrollar los canales de venta en línea de Baking Alchemy.

* Administrar catálogo, promociones, contenidos, inventarios y experiencia de compra.

* Implementar estrategias para aumentar tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio y recompra.

* Coordinar campañas de performance, marketplaces y automatizaciones comerciales.

* Analizar métricas y proponer mejoras continuas al embudo digital.




Redes sociales y contenido




* Crear y administrar el calendario de contenidos.

* Desarrollar publicaciones, campañas, videos, recetas y materiales educativos.

* Coordinar colaboraciones con chefs, reposteros, creadores de contenido y comunidades.

* Gestionar la interacción con usuarios y fortalecer la comunidad digital.

* Medir alcance, engagement, generación de demanda y conversión.




¿Qué buscamos?




* Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad, Negocios, Diseño o áreas relacionadas.

* Entre 3 y 6 años de experiencia en marketing, e-commerce, trade marketing o gestión de marca.

* Experiencia deseable en alimentos, productos de consumo, retail o Food Service.

* Manejo de redes sociales, plataformas de e-commerce, marketplaces y herramientas de análisis.

* Experiencia coordinando campañas digitales y acciones en punto de venta.

* Conocimientos de Meta Ads, Google Ads, CRM, email marketing y analítica digital.

* Inglés intermedio deseable.




Competencias clave




* Creatividad con enfoque comercial.

* Pensamiento estratégico y capacidad de ejecución.

* Sensibilidad por la marca y atención al detalle.

* Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.

* Capacidad para analizar datos y convertirlos en acciones.

* Mentalidad emprendedora y autonomía.

* Facilidad para colaborar con ventas, operaciones, agencias y proveedores.

* Afinidad con la gastronomía, panadería o repostería.




¿Cómo se verá el éxito?




* Mayor reconocimiento y preferencia de marca.

* Crecimiento sostenido del canal e-commerce.

* Incremento en tráfico, conversión, ticket promedio y recompra.

* Mayor visibilidad y rotación en puntos de venta.

* Comunidad digital activa y comprometida.

* Campañas comerciales medibles y alineadas con los objetivos de venta.

* Una identidad de marca consistente en todos los canales.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




* Sueldo competitivo y esquema de crecimiento.

* Autonomía para desarrollar la estrategia de marketing.

* Participación directa en la construcción de una marca en expansión.

* Capacitación continua y exposición a proyectos de innovación.

* Ambiente dinámico, creativo y colaborativo.

* Oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de Baking Alchemy, The Uncommon Lab e Interlub Group.




Buscamos a una persona que disfrute construir marcas, crear comunidad y transformar ideas en resultados comerciales.

About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Associate Consultant, Strategy & Transformation, Launch Program 2027 - Mexico City, Mexico

Associate Consultant, Launch Program – 2027

At Mastercard, our Advisors & Consulting Services (ACS) group helps clients drive impact through data-driven insights, hands-on implementation, and a collaborative, tech-enabled culture. We invest in talent through global engagements, continuous learning, and programs like the Global Ambassadors Program, while fostering purpose through volunteerism, pro-bono work, and innovation that benefits both clients and communities.

Make an Impact as an Associate Consultant

As an Associate Consultant, you will collaborate within small teams to help some of the world's biggest brands answer and implement solutions for their most challenging strategic questions. You will immediately create meaningful contributions through taking ownership of deliverables and building external relationships with clients. Focusing on technology and data, you will gain broad exposure to a range of industries, including financial services, retail, restaurants, hospitality and more.

Specialization Track

We are looking for passionate and talented professionals, who share our vision for helping our customers with their most urgent business needs, and we are recruiting for four career tracks that make up our team. Track placement will indicate the types of projects where you will spend most of your time; however, we encourage and enable working across tracks to allow team members to acquire diverse skills and experiences.

Strategy & Transformation

Guide clients through strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational challenges to enhance performance and operations. Our engagements cover diverse areas, including product development, marketing, customer loyalty, and innovation. Working with clients from various industries, many S&T engagements directly interface with numerous Fortune 500 companies. This role aligns with the practices of traditional management consulting firms.

Sampling Of Questions We Help Our Customers Answer


 How can a global financial services institution be successful at entering a hyper competitive new market?
 How can a customer improve its operating model to better achieve operational, financial and strategic goals?
 Team members typically support 1-3 projects concurrently, with each project lasting for approximately 8-16 weeks.
 Bring your Passion and Expertise



We Recruit For And Value The Following Core Competencies

Passion: Actively seeks responsibility and takes pride in delivering the highest quality results and recommendations to our clients. Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities.

Analytic Excellence: Demonstrates a strong aptitude for structured problem solving, analytical and quantitative skills. Experience using data analysis or querying tools (e.g., SQL, SAS, Excel or Tableau) is an asset (particularly for Performance Analytics or Business Experimentation tracks).

Business Interest: Clear interest in the world of business, and intuition for the way that companies make decisions.

Rapid Growth: Eagerness to learn quickly, both through Mastercard's structured training curriculum and organic development opportunities.

Teamwork: Willingness to work within small teams to produce outstanding deliverables, with a will to win attitude.

Integrity: Outstanding record of academic achievement. Commitment to Mastercard's values of honesty and integrity with a willingness to embrace and learn from mistakes.

Diverse Perspective: Brings a unique skillset or approach to the table in every client engagement or internal activity.

Communication: Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Qualifications


 Undergraduate degree with a graduation date between August 2025 – December 2026;
 Outstanding record of academic achievement;
 Proven record of leadership in a work setting and/or through extracurricular activities;
 Exceptional analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills;
 Ability to communicate ideas effectively – both verbally and in writing – in English and the local office language(s)

VACANTE PARA COORDINADOR DE MARKETING




Somos una agencia creativa con más de 10 años de experiencia generando conexiones reales entre marcas y personas.




Diseñamos campañas publicitarias que integran lo mejor de dos mundos:

Activaciones y medios físicos de alto impacto junto con estrategias digitales de contenido, social media y paid media.




Buscamos una persona organizada, estratégica y resolutiva, capaz de convertir datos, insights del consumidor y objetivos de negocio en estrategias de marketing orientadas al crecimiento, posicionamiento y generación de resultados medibles. • Pensamiento estratégico y visión de negocio.

• Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.

• Organización y gestión de múltiples proyectos.

• Comunicación efectiva y trabajo colaborativo.

• Proactividad, adaptabilidad y aprendizaje constante.




Habilidades técnicas.

• Conocimiento de planeación estratégica de marketing y posicionamiento.

• Desarrollo de buyer personas, segmentación de audiencias y customer journey mapping.

• Desarrollo de calendarios editoriales, planes de contenido y briefs creativos.

• Habilidades de copywriting y redacción para diferentes formatos y plataformas.

• Experiencia en campañas publicitarias digitales (Meta Ads, Google Ads o similares).

• Interpretación de métricas, KPIs y análisis de desempeño.

Where should a retailer open new stores to maximize profitability and minimize the cannibalization of nearby omnichannel sales?
